intro: Seeking Strahad is an undertaking entrusted to Horde warlocks by Carendin Halgar in the Undercity. Halgar directs his pupil across the Great Sea to the dusty hills above Ratchet, where a human sorcerer holds the keys to deeper, more dangerous summonings. It marks the transition from foundational shadowcraft to the demanding art of conjuring a felhunter.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have taught you skills in the past, but the time has come for another to teach you. He is in Ratchet, and his name is Strahad. He is human, but do not let that fool you into thinking he is weak, nor is he your enemy... At least for now. He is powerful and should be respected. He can teach you about greater summonings, summonings I feel you are prepared for. Go to him now.
You can find him in Ratchet... Above the port town next to the tower there.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A busy day in Ratchet, isn't it? How I enjoy watching the toil of a port city. So much mystery, so much adventure... So much ignorance.
Is that hatred I see in your eyes, friend? Good, we will put that to good use.
